rows.dwa: Design electromechanical equipment or systems.
rows.task: Develop, test, or program new robots. · Modify, maintain, or repair electrical, electronic, or mechanical components, equipment, or systems to ensure proper functioning.

evidence.quote: Prepare and interpret programs for CNC mills.
evidence.basis: programming CNC mills to construct new tool paths constitutes designing/programming the equipment's operation

lead.quote: Prepare and interpret programs for CNC mills.
lead.reason: default: tier, units, catalog order

rows.dwa: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.
rows.task: Develop, test, or program new robots. · Test performance of electromechanical assemblies, using test instruments such as oscilloscopes, electronic voltmeters, or bridges. · Select and use laboratory, operational, or diagnostic techniques or test equipment to assess electromechanical circuits, equipment, processes, systems, or subsystems. · Operate, test, or maintain robotic equipment used for green production applications, such as waste-to-energy conversion systems, minimization of material waste, or replacement of human operators in dangerous work environments.

evidence.quote: Verify CNC programs by means of machine simulators and software verification tools.
evidence.basis: verifying CNC programs via simulators tests the performance of the integrated mechanical/control system

evidence.quote: Verify mill programs with PC based solid modeling software.
evidence.basis: software-based verification of tool paths constitutes testing performance of the machine system before run

evidence.quote: Verify tool paths.
evidence.basis: verifying tool paths is testing the programmed system's performance before running on the machine

evidence.quote: Safely test program with single block and adjusted feed rates.
evidence.basis: testing a CNC program's performance on the machine matches testing performance of an integrated system

lead.quote: Safely test program with single block and adjusted feed rates.
lead.reason: content outline names the exact procedure of safely test-running a program, matching 'test performance' most specifically versus the others which address verification/tool-path checking rather than performance testing

rows.dwa: Develop software or computer applications.
rows.task: Install or program computer hardware or machine or instrumentation software in microprocessor-based systems.

evidence.quote: Prepare basic three-axis programming for milling machine operations
evidence.basis: writing CNC part programs is programming machine/instrumentation software for a microprocessor-based (CNC controller) system

evidence.quote: Create basic word-address programs to successfully construct projects using vertical machining centers.
evidence.basis: programming machine controller software directly matches installing/programming machine or instrumentation software

evidence.quote: Operate mill CNC controller to download and dry run part programs
evidence.basis: downloading and running programs on the machine controller evidences programming instrumentation software

evidence.quote: Create advanced word-address programs to successfully construct projects using vertical machining centers.
evidence.basis: authoring advanced CNC programs is developing software for the machine's control system

evidence.quote: Verify mill programs with PC based solid modeling software.
evidence.basis: writing and verifying programs on the controller software is developing/programming software applications for the machine

evidence.quote: Call up and run programs in memory.
evidence.basis: operating machine control software/programs matches installing or programming machine instrumentation software

evidence.quote: Input and operate in MDI.
evidence.basis: manual data input to the CNC controller is programming machine software in a microprocessor-based system

lead.quote: Create basic word-address programs to successfully construct projects using vertical machining centers.
lead.reason: SLO commits the course to creating (programming) word-address programs on CNC controllers, matching 'develop software' most directly and at the higher SLO tier

evidence.basis: identifying drawing projections/views is directly constitutive of reading blueprints/schematics

evidence.quote: Detail and assembly views
evidence.basis: interpreting detail and assembly views is scope of reading technical drawings to determine assembly sequence

lead.quote: Demonstrate the ability to interpret multi-view drawings and prints.
lead.reason: SLO states interpreting multi-view drawings and prints, directly matching reading blueprints/schematics to plan work, at the highest section tier
